correctness.rationale: All 24 quartic generators are reduced in an explicit 35-coordinate binary vector space, giving degree-four ideal rank20 and quotient rank16 after 4 linearly independent G·linear relations. All 65536 masks are checked at all 15 rational points; 288 survive. Exact four-chart Jacobian Gröbner unit-ideal checks on all 288 yield precisely 144 geometrically smooth masks, reported in five complete disjoint chunks and replayed by attached checker. For smooth sections the Koszul genus calculation gives genus19; the Hasse–Witt Frobenius coefficient formula for (3,4) complete intersections gives a 19x19 matrix of rank19 for every one of the 144 masks. No finite-point-only test is substituted for geometric smoothness.

value.rationale: For the canonical minimal-degree space-filling construction over F2, the fixed cubic and its quartic linear system form a natural finite parameter space. The complete count 144, the gap from 288 locally smooth choices, and universal ordinarity supply exact structural information about the arithmetic geometry and generic-versus-geometric smoothness of all minimal-degree genus-19 curves within that system. This enables reproducible searches and Jacobian p-rank studies, rather than an arbitrary isolated small-field tabulation.
